findings.issue: Async caller mutation can replace signed bytes or authority objects after validation and before the send invocation.
findings.requiredFix: Capture immutable signed bytes and sender callback; clone security-sensitive inputs before awaits; test attempted substitution.
findings.fix: Capture signed bytes/sender, security material, trusted signer identities and callback functions before awaits; freeze phase rules and issued results.
findings.evidence: Acceptance 4 attempts asynchronous signed-bytes, gas, transport and trust substitution; original captured bytes are the only invocation.

findings.issue: Exact pre-arm trace only binds token/curve/vault results, not complete roles/assets/payout/lock/creation postconditions; config bytes can disagree with declared payout.
findings.requiredFix: Validate full observed creation semantics and encoded payout; inspect the whole semantic manifest for literal provisional-vault dependencies.
findings.fix: Complete observed creation postconditions in the exact trace; encoded payout must match the manifest; whole-manifest literal-vault guard; actual supply equals frozen economics.
findings.evidence: Acceptances 3 and 5 reject mismatched payout bytes, lock, roles, assets and supply; the factory-nonce counterfactual accepts the actual vault only with identical semantics.

findings.issue: Pre-send reads do not re-run the exact call, and callback-supplied time can miss expiry while async validation runs.
findings.requiredFix: Fresh pinned exact eth_call immediately before invocation; trusted-clock checks after awaits; test revert and expiry with zero sends.
findings.fix: Durable intent then fresh critical reads and exact pinned eth_call, latest/pending wallet reads, and trusted-clock expiry/freshness checks after awaits.
findings.evidence: Acceptance 4 fresh call revert and expiry during the call each produce zero sends; uncertain timeout cannot resend.

findings.issue: Mandatory code/controller inventory omits known fee-hook/escrow/locker/graduation dependencies and asset contracts; post-verifier does not compare all graph bindings through finality.
findings.target: semantic manifest, authority read plan and execution verifier
findings.requiredFix: Require known critical dependency bindings/codehashes, asset contracts where applicable, and post-execution graph/controller verification.
findings.fix: Require all eleven baseline dependencies plus ERC20 asset authority, owners/controller codehashes and graph bindings at pinned reads and both launch/finalized verification blocks.
findings.evidence: Acceptances 2 and 5 reject omitted dependencies, asset code omissions, critical read/code drift, and code/owner/graph changes after the launch block.

scopeLimit: Implementation review and synthetic acceptance only; deployed upstream behavior, legal authority and real launch readiness are not established.
